correctness.rationale: The negation is antitone by P5 and consequent monotonicity; semicomplementation with double-negation inflation forces exactly a finite threshold j. The converse construction satisfies all P1-P5 plus the T/F axioms; independent activation times count the maps bijectively. A direct exhaustive table search through m=4 agrees as a complete set with the normal-form construction, and canonical axioms verify through m=5. All m>=2 follows deductively, not by interpolation.
